  "phoneNote": "The food photo and traditional typography suit the gostilna, but widely separated, equally styled hero links weaken the route from introduction to action.",

    "Tighten the phone hero’s action area, give calling a clear primary treatment, and provide the required fixed call/directions bar, which is not visible here.",
    "Use two desktop columns for the menu categories and integrate opening hours into a compact practical-information section rather than leaving most of the row empty.",
    "Reduce the oversized footer business name and compress the footer so contact information, rather than repeated branding, becomes its visual focus."
